IS_TEST().notice: Marker used by Forge to identify test contracts.

failed().notice: Returns true if any test assertion has failed.

targetSenders().notice: Returns sender allowlist configured via `targetSender` (empty means no sender allowlist).

test_acceptBeyondCapReverts().notice: Spec: accepting a job whose reward exceeds the remaining cap is refused.

test_acceptOutsideAllowlistReverts().notice: Spec: a kind outside the allowlist is refused.

test_approveByReviewerPaysAgentOnce().notice: Spec: approve releases the escrow to the agent exactly once.

test_approveByTheAgentReverts().notice: Spec: the agent never reviews its own job.

test_deactivatedAgentCannotAccept().notice: Spec: an inactive agent cannot accept a job.

test_deliverOnlyByTheAgent().notice: Spec: only the accepting agent delivers, once.

test_expiredMandateRefusesNewJobs().notice: Spec: an expired mandate refuses accept.

test_followUpOnceWithinCap().notice: Spec: one follow-up per approved job, within the mandate cap.

test_grantMandateBadSignatureReverts().notice: Spec: a signature from another signer is refused.

test_grantMandateEmptyOrOversizedAllowli.notice: Spec: the allowlist has 1 to 16 kinds.

test_grantMandatePastExpiryReverts().notice: Spec: an expiry in the past is refused.

test_grantMandateReplayedNonceReverts().notice: Spec: a replayed (grantor, nonce) is refused.

test_grantMandateStoresTerms().notice: Spec: a valid signed grant stores agent, cap, expiry and allowlist.

test_grantMandateZeroCapReverts().notice: Spec: a zero cap is refused.

test_postEscrowsTheReward().notice: Spec: post pulls exactly the reward into escrow.

test_refundExpiredAfterDeadlineOnly().notice: Spec: an unfinished job is refunded only after its deadline.

test_registerAgentOnlyAdmin().notice: Spec: only an admin registers an agent.

test_registerAgentRankBelowCaller().notice: Spec: the registered rank must be below the registrar's.

test_rejectRefundsThePoster().notice: Spec: reject refunds the escrow to the poster.

test_revocationKeepsAcceptedJobAlive().notice: Spec: a job accepted before revocation still ends by approve, reject or refund.

test_revokeMandateByHigherRank().notice: Spec: a higher rank revokes any mandate below it.

test_revokedMandateRefusesNewJobs().notice: Spec: a revoked mandate refuses accept.

test_spentGrowsByRewardOnAccept().notice: Spec: spent grows by the reward and never shrinks.
